h1: Tag management, with every tracking tag in one place
overview: When tracking code is pasted into your theme by different people over time, nobody knows what runs or why. We set up Google Tag Manager in your account, move your tags into it, delete the ones that are dead and name everything clearly. Then we test each tag, publish the container and write down how it works, so you can change tracking without touching the site code.

faq: Is Tag Manager really worth using on a small store?

If you have three or more tags, yes. Changes become safer, you can undo a mistake in a click, and the site loads one script instead of many. For one or two tags, we may suggest leaving things as they are.
Will moving tags break my tracking?

Not if done in order. We build everything in preview first, compare numbers before and after and only remove the old code once the new tags report the same. We keep a copy of the old setup for safety.
Does it work with Shopify checkout?
Shopify limits what can run on checkout pages, so some tags need Shopify's own Customer Events or the app's integration. We pick the method that works for your plan and explain the limits.
